messages:
ana: Quick poll — pack a 3-song capsule that gets you through ANY mood. Drop your three and optionally one book/show that pairs well. I'll go first.
mike: 1) Phoenix — Lisztomania (instant sunny lift) 2) Burial — Archangel (late-night calm) 3) Beyoncé — Sandcastles (emotional reset). Pair: The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle for weird, slow days.
sarah: Love this. Mine: 1) Fleet Foxes — Blue Ridge Mountains 2) LCD Soundsystem — New York, I Love You But You're Bringing Me Down 3) Janelle Monáe — Make Me Feel. Pair: Fleabag S1 (cheeky + raw).
julia: Not great at limiting to three but: 1) M83 — Wait 2) Portishead — Roads 3) Chairlift — Bruises. :heart:
kevin: Synthwave corner: 1) Kavinsky — Nightcall 2) Chromatics — Shadow 3) Perturbator — Future Club. Pair: Drive (movie). :sunglasses:
ben: Warm indie set: 1) Sufjan Stevens — Should Have Known Better 2) Angel Olsen — Windows 3) Radiohead — Sail to the Moon. Book pair: Norwegian Wood.
nana: (typo oops) — meant to say ana earlier! also adding a wildcard meme song: A-ha — Take On Me for pure absurd joy.
nana: also vote emoji idea: we should have a tiny reaction poll for 'most versatile capsule' :thinking_face:
mike: added Sandcastles to my commute playlist ❤️ thanks @sarah
sarah: small PSA — I auto-generated a playlist from these picks: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/abc123 (bot made it, not me). Use freely.
ben: vote recorded: @mike for most emotionally versatile :1st_place_medal: 
kevin: can someone craft a 3-song capsule specifically for "Monday debugging"? I need survival tunes.
nana: @kevin i'll toss one together after lunch. also unrelated: kitchen plants are wilting, pls water if you're around this afternoon :seedling:
julia: noted, i'll water them tomorrow morning :ok_hand: 
music-bot: Playlist "3-song-capsule-thread" created with 20 tracks (auto message).
nana: thanks all — love the variety. if anyone wants their picks added to the public office mix, drop them in this thread and i'll queue them up. :coffee:
